title: plagiogyria egenolfioides var. sumatrana
intro: Plagiogyria egenolfioides var. sumatrana, commonly known as Sumatran Plagiogyria, is a species of fern in the family Polypodiaceae. It is a type of plant that has been traditionally used in medicine for its potential health benefits. The health benefits of Sumatran Plagiogyria include its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and other inflammatory conditions, due to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
